name: QA Table Mailer
description: Select a table or area in Excel Online (or any spreadsheet), copy it, and email it through Outlook via the workstation's Mailer — edit the cells first, pick a template and receiver group, send now or save it as a scheduled job.
features: 📋 Grab copied table: select cells in Excel Online / Google Sheets / desktop Excel, Ctrl+C, one click — the plugin reads the copied table (HTML or tab-separated)
✏️ Edit the selected area before sending: click any cell, add or remove rows and columns, use the first row as the header
📧 Send through Outlook: the workstation sends via your desktop Outlook (Windows/macOS) or SMTP — no app registration; optional review-in-Outlook before sending
🧾 HTML email templates with {{table}}, {{date}}, {{job}} placeholders — saved and edited with live preview on the workstation's Mailer page
👥 Saved receiver groups (To / Cc / Bcc) plus one-off addresses
⏰ Save as job: schedule daily/weekday sends that run on your PC while the workstation is open; live data from a OneDrive-synced .xlsx or the saved table; every send is logged
💾 All configuration (jobs, templates, receivers, Outlook settings) is saved in the workstation's data folder
